title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear AXZ: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
justification: AniList: 4 omake of 8 min, 2017-11-29 to 2018-02-28, 戦姫絶唱しないシンフォギア. AniDB 11955 S2-S5 are four compilation specials on 2017-11-29, 12-27, 2018-01-31, 02-28; S1 "Symphogear Live 2016 Digest" (2017-09-03) is a different thing. TVDB 254667 season 0 0x8-0x11 "Not-So-Superb Song of the Valkyries: Symphogear AXZ 1-4" on the same four dates, 0x7 "Symphogear Live 2016 Digest" = S1; the parent's row offset 6 already places S1-S5 on 0x7-0x11. Consecutive S2-S5, four = AniList's four. No collision (GX takes 0x3-0x6, XV 0x13-0x16).
